run_evaluation: run the evaluation pipeline for a competition submission using a config JSON file
generate_submission_file: generate a submission file by running script.py in a sandboxed subprocess with a time limit
upload_submission_file: upload a generated submission file to the Hugging Face competition repository
review_run_function: review the run function that orchestrates submission evaluation including requirements installation and metric computation
refactor_generate_submission_file: refactor generate_submission_file to support additional sandbox execution options or file upload formats
